incidents.summary: PCF discovered an unauthorized login to a standalone email-list website that held a subset of Amara user emails/names/usernames. No passwords. Site decommissioned 2018-05-10. PCF reported the incident isolated from Amara.org.

research.searchCoverage: Official Amara x-api-key REST at https://amara.org/api. Historical 2018-05-24 PCF mailing-list website incident retained; PCF said it did not affect Amara.org. Dated search on 2026-09-13 found no current unresolved Amara API compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

selection.ownership: Participatory Culture Foundation (PCF) operates Amara at amara.org. The reviewed edition is the international HTTPS API at amara.org/api, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Amara API authentication (x-api-key), users/videos/teams/languages endpoints, PCF security page, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. A 2018-05-24 PCF mailing-list website incident is retained as historical evidence; PCF reported it isolated from Amara.org and remediated by decommissioning that site. No current unresolved Amara API compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.
